title: group_create — input
description: Input schema for the SOX group_create operation. Creates a new group channel under the group/<group-id> prefix and adds the creating agent as the first active member. The caller supplies the bare group ID (without prefix); the server prepends 'group/' to form the full channel name. Normative reference: spec/primitives/groups.md §5.1.

group_id.description: The bare group identifier without the 'group/' prefix. The server prepends 'group/' to form the full channel name (e.g. 'eng-team' becomes 'group/eng-team'). MUST be unique within the namespace.

display_name.description: Optional human-readable name for tooling display. Not used in routing or membership enforcement.

namespace.description: Namespace scope for the group channel. Defaults to 'default'.

replay_policy.description: Controls who may call the replay verb on this group channel. 'subscriber': any active member may replay. 'admin_only': requires admin capability. 'custom': channel owner registers a replay-specific middleware sub-chain. See spec/primitives/channels.md §6.1.
